notes.title: Playtest Patch - first fixes incoming
notes.content:
After the first feedback we received we managed to roll out a couple of updates and fixes. Most are adressing issues in the tutorial, where some people had problems with input and also there where some situations that made it hard for the players to finish after resets.

In detail:

[general]

 Racer in Tutorial is slightly slower - was too fast for some
 Shop shows amount of entry money needed


[Tutorial]

 fixed issue where resetting the Bouncing tutorial step made it impossible to finish
 Added reminding voicelines when failing too often
 Added images for illustration purposes and to introduce elements more clearly


[gamepad]

 Bug with LeftStick scheme for gamepad resetting to other layout fixed
 Bug with LeftStick inverting Y-Axis fixed
 Strafing also possible with D-Pad now


With that we hope it's much more comfortable for new users and especially gamepad users from now on.
Please let us know when you encounter anything by using the feedback option ingame or here directly.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44622053/81e39d582423d633900be662815e92a35ba02725.png

Thanks for your support! Join the playtest until the 7th of April.

Your StarBoost Team!

notes.title: the StarBoost PLAYTEST is open now: We need your feedback!

If you want to join the discord channel and discuss there: here is the ticket

notes.title: [DEV NEWS] Hitting a new milestone & playtesting
notes.content:
It’s update time!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44622053/62428fa1459c3c331d50da837109aac91998e188.png

The last months were super productive in many ways – StarBoost is way more in shape than it has ever been. And that is not a result of just “putting in the hours” but refinining the concept and game mechanics over and over again. We are now really at the point, where we can confidently say: StarBoost is a 360° action parcour racer. And then feel that ring true when you are on the the race track and playing.

Playtesting

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44622053/ed9d9f21811ba8da5720955da5c988a20863997e.png

We refined a vertical slice with a selection of maps from the first planet ready to be playtested very soon.  We have a couple loyal playtesters who go in and test again and again, and we ourselves are testing a ton. BUT. There might be some issues we overlook out of familiarity with the game. This is a very dangerous zone to be in: you can make the game look good and how it actually should be working once you know it well playing yourself – but you as the developer just might not anticipate in how many funny ways players will break that. Knowingly or unknowingly 😉 This is our biggest focus right now: making it as approachable for new players as possible!

We are preparing the last steps as I write this and will go into a STEAM PLAYTEST soon.

see the detailed version on our site: 
StarBoost website - devlog

Back very, very soon!  ːsteamthumbsupː


Cheers,
your StarBoost Team!

notes.title: StarBoost Demo - Buildlog 0.8.25

In detail:

Buildlog 0.8.25

FIXES

 latest race highscore not showing when back in menu -fixed
 Race 01 hard to get into segments and pulling to main track -fixed
 Achievement notifications sometimes not triggering correctly when player in menu - fixed

notes.title: Demo Build Update 0.8.24
notes.content:
We have just published a new build for the demo. In that update a couple of bugs we noticed and feedback points from users are adressed. The main update announced a week ago was the input possibility added for keyboard/mouse and there were still some graphical feedback and sound updates needed to complete that feature. Additionally we noticed there were some rough spots in the first tutorial where in case you died or missed  the tutorial action to do during the weapon system test there was a bug that led to the ship being pulled away and flying no longer was doable.

In detail:

Buildlog 0.8.24

FIXES

 Gamepad pulling down the racing ship or in general dragging in a direction when no input is made - fixed
 Tut Basics map: endless pitch and tutorial not triggering  - fixed
 Switching to alternative gamepad input scheme not triggering - fixed
 Respawning in Tut Basics map not forcing racer to wrong direction


IMPROVEMENS:

 Fluid switch between gamepad and kbm at any point has more UI feedback and also shows an icon for which one is registered in the GUI
 Editing profiles now has either Keyboard input or spawns a virtual keyboard when gamepad is active
  Voice feedback or board computer now responding to correct input active
 Respawning in general more lenient and giving player more chance to re-orient


ADDITIONS:
Powerups now have a visualiziation added on the racer with various 3d elements on equipping.

notes.title: Dev Update - New INPUT for you!
notes.content:
Dear StarBoosters,

after SteamNext the main feedback we got was that  input is not as easy to adapt to as it could be...
Mainly we received quite some notes about the missing Keyboard & Mouse integration for players not having a gamepad or not beeing used to it too much. 
Originally we envisioned StarBoost to be most enjoyable with a Gamepad but of course we noticed this was a common theme - so we react to it. 
Putting in a lof of hours to get that out quickly: Keyboard and mouse is now fully integrated into the game, so cruising the GUI and also playing with KBM is entirely possible. 
To be honest: we even feel like this is surprisingly comfortable for ourselves as well - and we have hundreds if not thousands of hours of controller practice with the game ;) 

But that aside: of course we want to make the entry barriers and frustration points for new players as low as possible, so that feedback was immensely helpful and we hope it smoothes out any discomforts new players would have.

Update
We are still ironing out little bugs here and there but we feel like this is a great addition to StarBoost and hope to reach an entire new group of players with that update. The update is live NOW with a build we just uploaded: 0.8.2 Alpha. The next step for us is to add customizable input for players in general to the game, this will be targeted for the next weeks.

Feedback
As always: we are still in a phase where we profit greatly from constructive feedback like in this case where we could react quickly to a weak point of the game. So if you feel like you notice something that could be better or just want to share your view on some aspects of the game: 
leave a message on the discussion board here on steam or send us a mail via the StarBoost feedback form.


Happy racing,
your StarBoost team

notes.title: StarBoost - Updates & Plans
notes.content:
Post Steam Next - StarBoost Updates

With the DEMO release on Steam Next Festival we have reached an important milestone.
StarBoost has gone public and we are proud to say that so far the experience has been quite good. We decided to keep the demo online and up to date - so don‘t worry if you missed SteamNext...

All in all the game was really stable for a first shot which is what we worked towards. Though we could have climbed the charts a bit higher, StarBoost has been seen, tested and wishlisted in many parts of the world.

We got feedback about some issues and aspects of the game not working great yet and we already implemented some of the changes to make the controls and the tutorials smoother.

Thanks to everyone who has send a feedback form or left a post in the game's discussion board - that is helping greatly to smooth out any frustration points new players might have!

Our vision of StarBoost hast grown and we are moving forward to the next big goal:
Early Access.

Next Steps
We have much more content and features planned before we go into EA. 
This includes improving the general racing feel, extending the action with more enemy types, powerups, special abilities and more, but also a part of the game that has been hidden away in the Demo: Discovery.

Discovery mode offers a more chill and unrestricted flight and unveils the background of intergalactic Racing Sport.
Apart from exploring and interacting with the world, players will discover and unlock hidden racetracks for solo/tournament mode and customize the track with different interact mechanics. 
Learning about the history and present of the tournament and earning more and more reputation and power as a successful racer, you get the chance to decide not only about the future of intergalactic racing sport, but also about its consequences for whole Civilizations and Planets.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44622053/89e02011e83c3e4d654282a8106d9987fe96e3ae.jpg

Build updates & Feedback
We are now continuing to iron out issues we noticed during the SteamNext week and patch the game with the most critical updates we worked on during the past week.
The most recent build just went online this evening and addresses a range of aspects, from balancing to straight bug fixes.
So we keep the demo up to date and are happy to appear on your wishlists and to receive more feedback.

Details about the build are posted in the Discussion Board for StarBoost: read more here


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44622053/7567ffe6aa2d270c22aad64008bf2972594dc067.jpg

Don't forget to wishlist the game if you like it so far - that helps us tremendously!


Thanks again and more to come very soon
- your StarBoost Team
